name: Breaker disconnected-position proof
aliases: switchgear Breaker position and status interfaces
summary: Identifies the documented disconnected truck position independently of an open main contact.
description: Identifies the documented disconnected truck position independently of an open main contact. Breaker status indications describe the operating mechanism, the removable truck or the health of a supporting system. These signals are related but are not interchangeable: an open breaker can still have its truck connected to live bus contacts.

In a switchgear control schematic, the bay controller compares independent status contacts before displaying a position or allowing another operation. The signal labels explain which physical state each contact represents. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Disconnected-position contact” at the input and “Disconnected truck status” at the output. Physical isolation requirements remain equipment-specific.

Keep contact reference conditions, terminal numbers and interpretation logic together. Distinguish a mechanically operated indication from a measured current or voltage condition.
